paragraphs.text: Active exploitation of critical vulnerabilities in Drupal core, Mitel MiCollab, and Cacti network monitoring platform, alongside CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog additions, demands immediate vulnerability management attention across technology stacks. Control owners must confirm patching status, compensating controls, and asset inventory coverage for these actively targeted systems.

Concurrent identity and cloud security failures, including a password manager breach bypassing two-factor authentication and a reported US Air Force cloud platform compromise, extend risk to access management and incident response domains. A medical device manufacturer data breach further underscores data protection accountability. Owners should validate authentication assurances, cloud containment procedures, and breach notification readiness.
